reasoning_content:
Build succeeded. Tests pass in isolation confirming timeouts are resource contention. Let me verify other mise tools work (audit-ish). Also verify generate-app-wrapper task exists, and check the runtime behavior of the app more thoroughly — maybe load the widget in the wrapper host page. Let me check the app actually renders by fetching assets.

Also let's verify `mise run check` components done. Let me check the tools binaries work: jq, trivy, fnox, etc. and verify mise run tasks list.

Let me also do a quick smoke of building the app's index.html rendered. But dev server isn't persistent across calls. The app is a React widget. The curl from dev server returned HTML. Good enough as operational evidence.

Let me verify the mise tasks and the individual tool binaries.
